faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Mu Neutro.
faq.q1: I created an account on the website, but the game says "Invalid Account."
faq.a1: The web account is for website and account management only. Create a sub-account in your dashboard to log into the game.
faq.q2: Can I open more than one game client?
faq.a2: Yes, you can log into multiple accounts at the same time, up to the allowed limit per computer.
faq.q3: Is the server free to play?
faq.a3: Yes, the server is free to play. The store offers optional items for convenience.
faq.q4: How can I get freebies or rewards?
faq.a4: Join our community, participate in events, and follow our social channels for giveaways.
faq.q5: Can I complete web quests on multiple accounts?
faq.a5: Yes. You can create multiple accounts and complete quests on each to receive rewards.
